## DG4 round 6: QA verdict is **PASS**

I reviewed candidate `sha256:f966fe57…` (source `1e0dc5d`, 1472 files) on a complete clone. It matched at the start and at the end. HEAD moved twice during my run, but both new commits only add the other reviewers' run evidence, which I did not read.

### F-DG4-145 is closed and verified
Recorded in `qa-verifier.verifications.json`.
- **Contention runs:** I repeated the four `pnpm test` runs at load 13–15, and also ran four at load 20–30. The three session test files passed 80/80 in all eight.
- **Pinned reproduction** (one CPU shared with three busy loops):
  - the pre-repair test file still fails the `/me` count 2/2;
  - the candidate never fails the count;
  - running only the Y1c cases, the candidate passes 2/2;
  - the same file with its controlled clock removed fails 2/2, so the clock is what fixes it.
- **Broken-code check:** I broke the identity rules one at a time. The tests catch window ignored, window never crossed, no navigation confirmation, and no generation check. Two other variants change nothing observable, because the query library already merges duplicate `/me` requests.
- **Repair diff:** tests only. No assertion of F-DG2-530/570/580 or D-077 is weakened.
- **Real stack:** my new probe passes 14/14 checks per language in both locale settings. `/me` is sent first and once per navigation, none while idle, and the new identity shows after another sign-in.

### Full review results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | 7/7 pass |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 and 24, both locales | 4/4 pass at load 3–9 (2917 tests, plus 259 passed and 2 skipped by design) |
| Integration, twice | 1975/1975 each; 61 migrations (the assignment says `0060`, the candidate ships `0061`); `contract.test.ts` 45/45; no pending entries |
| `tests/qa` alone | 172/172 |
| REQ-DLV-036 | 85/85: A04 12, A09 17, A10 16, A11 40 |
| e2e, locale unset (364 counted) | 334 passed, 13 failed, 17 did not run |
| e2e, C.UTF-8 (364 counted) | 359 passed, 2 failed, 3 did not run |
| e2e solo re-runs | every failed spec passed alone in the same locale setting |
| My round-4/5 probes | 546 + 77 checks per language, 0 failed, both locales |
| Validator (register, pipeline, historical DG3/DG2/DG1) | 5/5 pass |
| Requirement trace | 137/137 rows covered, nothing unresolved |

Of the 15 e2e failures, 14 are 30-second timeouts under load and one is F-DG4-147.

### New findings (all Low, not mandatory, not blocking)
- **F-DG4-146:** no test checks that a page request waits for the `/me` check already in flight. The broken-code variant that removes the wait passes all 1340 web unit tests, and it already passed before this repair. My held-`/me` test catches it and can serve as the fix.
- **F-DG4-147:** `session-end.spec.ts` "a 403 is not a session end" failed once in Arabic: expected 403, got 200. The trace shows a race in the test: the app's startup `/me` is sent after the page load and the test's re-login, so it correctly picks up the new session's token. The test passed in the C.UTF-8 run and when run alone.
- **F-DG4-148:** `pnpm test` is not reproducible at load 13 and above. It failed 6 of 8 times under load, but every failed test passes at load 3–9.
  - **Web tests:** the first page render in five web test files misses its 5-second wait.
  - **Architecture test:** `architecture.test.ts` misses its 30-second timeout.
  - **Side effect:** when the first step fails, the nocodegen test project doesn't run at all.

### Problems in my own work, disclosed
- **Session probe:** the first two versions failed because of mistakes in the probe, not the product; version 3 passes.
- **Integration run 2:** the first attempt was stopped by my tool's 2-hour background limit and was re-run in full.
- **Explained failures:** every non-zero exit is explained in `RUN-NOTES.md`.

All data is synthetic, and no product gate (G1–G6) was decided. My disposable clones are removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG4/round-6/`
  - qa-verifier.json
  - qa-verifier.md
  - qa-verifier.verifications.json
  - qa-verifier.findings.json
- `test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-6/` (evidence, including RUN-NOTES.md)
- `test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-6/` (my tests)
